title: How many matches in the 2008/2009 season were held in Belgium?
question: How many matches in the 2008/2009 season were held in Belgium?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(cm.id)
FROM CountryMatch AS cm
JOIN League AS l ON cm.league_id = l.id
WHERE cm.season = '2008/2009'
  AND l.name LIKE '%Belgium%'
